business_problem: Bupa Australia needed a governed single source of truth because fragmented legacy platforms made it hard to join health, insurance, and customer data for analytics and personalization.
solution_summary: Bupa Australia uses Databricks Data + AI Platform, Unity Catalog, and Genie to support unified health data and analytics for personalized care. Bupa Australia needed a governed single source of truth because fragmented legacy platforms made it hard to join health, insurance, and customer data for analytics and personalization. In practice, the implementation governs access and lineage with Unity Catalog, runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform, and delivers outputs through Genie. Legacy operational and analytics data are consolidated into a governed cloud data layer; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic; results are surfaced through Genie. The case study reports How Bupa Australia Unified Health Data and Accelerated Analytics 8x with Databricks, 90% of business and customer data consolidated, and Onto one governed platform 2500+ data users, showing measurable improvement after the rollout.
business_outcome: Bupa Australia reported How Bupa Australia Unified Health Data and Accelerated Analytics 8x with Databricks, 90% of business and customer data consolidated, and Onto one governed platform 2500+ data users, improving unified health data and analytics for personalized care with measurable gains in productivity improvement, speed to market, scalability, and customer experience.
